siteDescription: Approximately 13,000 feet downstream of the confluence of the Shield and the Yellowstone Rivers
hwm_notes: A single-base RTK system was deployed as a differential level. The base receiver location was established as an autonomous position, and the objective points (HWMs) and a NGS benchmark (PID QX0521) were observed. The published elevation for the benchmark was used for vertical adjustments to the objective point elevations. A horizontal adjustment was not performed; thus, the HWMs' latitudes and longitudes are approximate coordinates.
